title: AI agency open-sources 147 agents #aiagency #multiagent #aicoding
description:
Phygital highlighted an open-sourced AI agency built as a working multi-agent system, not a simple prompt pack or showcase repo. The setup includes 147 specialized sub-agents organized by functions such as engineering, marketing, sales, and support, each with a defined role, personality, and workflow.

The key idea is to run AI more like an org chart than a single assistant. Instead of relying on one general-purpose coding agent, teams can deploy parallel agents with domain-specific expertise inside cloud code or connect the system to a code executor for real task execution.

That structure matters because specialization and parallelization can improve speed, coordination, and output quality across technical and business workflows. For builders using AI coding tools like standard chatbots, it signals a shift toward agent-based operations that mirror how real companies organize work.
